problem_text:
A logistics manager must select packages to ship in a cargo container. The available packages are:
* Package 1: volume 14 m³, revenue $261
* Package 2: volume 6 m³, revenue $108
* Package 3: volume 7 m³, revenue $272
* Package 4: volume 9 m³, revenue $109
* Package 5: volume 36 m³, revenue $276
* Package 6: volume 41 m³, revenue $230
* Package 7: volume 39 m³, revenue $212
* Package 8: volume 42 m³, revenue $144
* Package 9: volume 44 m³, revenue $251
* Package 10: volume 41 m³, revenue $24
* Package 11: volume 23 m³, revenue $186
* Package 12: volume 50 m³, revenue $115
* Package 13: volume 45 m³, revenue $27
* Package 14: volume 13 m³, revenue $235
* Package 15: volume 14 m³, revenue $275
* Package 16: volume 44 m³, revenue $118
* Package 17: volume 1 m³, revenue $83
* Package 18: volume 16 m³, revenue $242

The container has a maximum capacity of 339 m³. Choose the package combination that yields the highest total revenue without exceeding this volume limit. Each package must be shipped entirely or not at all.
